items.headline: Citigroup Maintains Sell on Gemini Space Station, Lowers Price Target to $3.2
items.summary: Citigroup  analyst Peter Christiansen   maintains Gemini Space Station (NASDAQ:GEMI) with a Sell and lowers the price target from $4 to $3.2.
